What are your thoughts on Bitcoin?
As far as currency goes, I put my trust in lead.

Bitcoin is outdated, slow, and very expensive (tx fees). The crypto world has much better currency and utility tokens out there.

Despite that I still hope Bitcoin continues to grow and improve.

• I believe in decentralized control of money.
  • I believe in the free market of ideas and commerce. You can't truly have either unless you have a free market of money.

If I may explain: The most important value in all of the world's economy is the future value of money. (Aka interest rates.) This tells the business man how much he should invest for the future and this tells the saver how much he should save for the future. For the past ~100 years, this has been 100% controlled by central banks. Ergo, we do not have a free market of money. Ergo, we don't really have a free market.

Gold / Silver are great, but they are had to transfer in a digital / global world. Bitcoin (and the block chain in general) attempts to solve this.

Bitcoin isn't perfect. Lots of good, but there have been significant scaling pains. Right now, there are 1000+ other cryptocurrencies trying to be the perfect solution.

The best analogy that I've heard is when the railroad was invented in the UK. Shortly after the invention, there were 100+ railroad companies trying to be the best solution. Today, there are only a few, the rest have died. But, without these failed railroads, the network of railroads wouldn't have expanded so quickly and the UK economy wouldn't have been industrialized so quickly.

Bitcoin has first mover advantage, but there are other options that have have better features. (And, just like the early railroad companies - there are lots of get rich quick scams out there.)

Bottom line: if you believe the government is all powerful and has your absolute best interest in mind, then there is no need for alternative currencies. But, if you don't trust the government's management of money, spending, and debt ... then you should look for alternatives.

But, the government is powerful and won't go quietly into the night. But, failing monetary systems never do.

All in all, it's going to be an interesting ride.
